correctness.rationale: PASS: Differentiating cubic words forces both generator-image constant terms to vanish for every characteristic, and freely choosing linear M∈M2(F_q) and quadratic B∈M_{4x2}(F_q) gives exactly q^12 derivations. On V⊕(V⊗V), D=[[M,0],[B,T_M]] with T_M=M⊗I+I⊗M. Its rank equals rank M+rank T_M plus rank of uniform induced map ker M→coker T_M. For odd characteristic the T_M ranks from cyclic 2x2 normal form partition M into zero, rank1 trace0, rank1 trace nonzero, invertible trace0 and invertible trace nonzero; in characteristic2 nonzero scalar M gives T_M=0, all nonscalars rank T_M=2. Exact 2x2 class sizes and uniform B fiber law give all displayed N0..N6; sums equal q^12. Independently enumerated all 2^12=4096 derivations via bitwise exact rank over F2, obtaining [1,45,466,576,3008,0,0] (matches theorem). The inspected full source check_derivations.py additionally describes exhaustive F3 and sampled F4/F5 checks, but its logged results alone were not used as proof.
